name: nobi-dashboard-styles
description: Builds assets/css/tailwind.css locally. The dashboard must not depend on a CDN for layout: without it every utility class disappears and the page collapses.

scripts.css: tailwindcss -i assets/css/tailwind.src.css -o assets/css/tailwind.css --minify && node -e "require('fs').utimesSync('assets/css/tailwind.css', new Date(), new Date())"
